About the Practice

HonorHealth is a nonprofit health system serving the greater Phoenix metropolitan area with a comprehensive network that includes nine acute-care hospitals and over 70 primary, specialty, and urgent care locations. [10, 20] They offer a wide range of medical services and specialties such as behavioral health, cancer and hematology, heart and vascular care, neuroscience, orthopedics, trauma services, primary care, various surgical services, and women's health. [6, 20] The system also encompasses a cancer care network, outpatient surgery centers, a research institute for clinical research, medical education, and community services, all dedicated to providing high-quality care and improving community health and well-being. [10, 20]

Electronic Health Record System

Epic

Primary Electronic Health Record System

Research Analysis
Methodology & Findings

HonorHealth utilizes MyChart as their patient portal. MyChart is the patient portal system provided by Epic, which is the electronic health record (EHR) system that HonorHealth uses. Through the HonorHealth MyChart patient portal, patients can access their medical information, schedule appointments, request prescription refills, and communicate with their healthcare providers. This is a secure online platform designed to provide patients with easy access to their health information and services. Several HonorHealth locations and facilities are connected to this patient portal.
